name: chuul
languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak

actions.name: pincer
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target is &Reference[grappled] (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} doesn't have two other creatures grappled.

actions.name: tentacles
actions.desc: One creature &reference[grappled apply=false] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be &Reference[poisoned] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=BrAr9lF8TvsDoyxu]]. Until this poison ends, the target is &Reference[paralyzed]. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The chuul makes two [[/item .7lnXqe8AnWhtnQh7]]{pincer} attacks. If the chuul is grappling a creature, the chuul can also use its [[/item .XUzROtGqVZS61Ofm]]{tentacles} once.

actions.name: sense magic
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} senses magic within 120 feet of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]{Detect Magic} spell but isn't itself magical.

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.
